about: The household's money flows (docs/LIFE_SYSTEMS.md 3a, Step 1). Negative amounts are money out. A flow fires either on a dated calendar rule (rule, from data/calendar.json) or every calendar week (every), at its hour. amount is a number (per payment), or 'net' (Tom's take-home pay), 'mortgage' (the fixed repayment), 'interest' (balance × annualRate ÷ 12), or { perYear, over } (a yearly bill split into equal payments). name is the ledger and shortfall text; log is the house log line. Sources: docs/FAMILY.md for the bills, Step 0 figures for the rest (see each 'source').

flows.name: Mortgage payment
flows.source: data/stocks.json (loan): fixed repayment over 300 months at 4.6%

flows.name: Council tax
flows.source: Birmingham 2026/27 Band C £2,100.36 a year (uktax.tools; conflict noted in docs/FAMILY.md). Band C chosen 2026-11-11.

flows.name: Water
flows.source: docs/FAMILY.md: Severn Trent 2026/27 average £587 a year

flows.name: Energy
flows.source: docs/FAMILY.md: Ofgem cap £1,723 a year (flat in L2; the cap changes from L11)

flows.name: Broadband
flows.source: Uswitch 2026 average £35.90 a month (via phonearena.com). Other sources give £22.86 to about £26 (Broadband Genie; broadbandswitch.uk citing Ofcom). The higher figure is used on purpose.

flows.name: Mobile phones
flows.source: Uswitch 2026 average £18.60 a month per phone (via phonearena.com), two phones

flows.name: Interest
flows.source: Moneyfacts average easy-access rate 2.53% AER, September 2026 (Treasury report)

flows.name: Food shopping
flows.source: ONS Family Food, FYE 2025: £33.63 a person a week at home (gov.uk) × 4 people. Averages all ages, so it is a tuning figure. Eating out is left out.

flows.name: Everyday spending
flows.source: ONS Family Spending, FYE 2025: recreation and culture £82.10 a week per household. Household goods, personal goods and clothing were not found as absolute figures, so this is an understatement.
